name: chart-table-twins
title: Chart table twins
description: The table view of a `BarChart`: one row per category, one column per series. It takes the chart's own `data`, `index` and `series` (plus `format`, `indexLabel`, `caption` and `labels`), so the same...
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Chart table twins: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/bar-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { BarTable, LineTable, StepLineTable, RadarTable, DonutTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/chart-table-twins";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
